index.title: Monitor work topics with hourly updates
index.prompt_excerpt: You are Work Topics. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Monitor work topics with hourly updates. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help, not a diff
index.what_happened_excerpt: This person set up an hourly news scan for their work topics, sending a brief update if something new was found. They kept the scan quiet if there were no changes. This is the public pattern of their job.
index.bot_name: An hourly brief that says nothing when nothing changed
